results.note: persist_missing_comparison (corroborate.py:277-289) calls persist_datapoint with the primary Ok value before recording NOT_CORROBORATED; the test asserts the mocked persist_datapoint was actually invoked with Ok(value=78300.70, ...), confirmed by reading both files directly.

coinbase.py:24-40 turns an httpx.HTTPStatusError (e.g. HTTP 500) into Error(reason=FETCH_FAILED); coinbase.py:62-64 turns an empty closed-candle list into Unavailable(reason=FETCH_FAILED), a structurally different type. corroborate.py:291-294 routes Error straight through unmodified (fires the switch) and Unavailable into NotCorroboratedRecord (does not). The test directly exercises and asserts both branches.

NotCorroboratedRecord (corroborate.py:39-48) is a slots=True dataclass with no divergence_bps/tolerance_bps_at_write fields at all, so hasattr(...) is structurally False, not runtime-false. The comparison_values_together CHECK constraint (migration lines 28-39, read directly) enforces divergence_bps/tolerance_bps_at_write IS NULL and reason IS NOT NULL whenever datapoint_b_id IS NULL, so the DB layer also refuses a fabricated zero.

corroboration_is_failure (corroborate.py:251-254) returns True only for isinstance(outcome, Error). coinbase.py:62-64 returns Unavailable, not Error, for a quiet market (no closed candles) -- the exact 'no ticks' shape from the story -- and the test confirms that outcome does not trip corroboration_is_failure while a real Error does.

record_not_corroborated (corroborate.py:148-186) takes a non-optional Reason and persists it in the 'reason' column; Reason is the same enum from ingest/status.py documented in 11_Data_Model.md lines 37-42 (NOT_DEFINABLE/PAYWALLED/FETCH_FAILED/NOT_FETCHED), and the doc explicitly lists 'empty after filtering' under FETCH_FAILED, matching coinbase.py's no-closed-candle case. Absence is never recorded without a reason (DB CHECK also enforces reason IS NOT NULL when datapoint_b_id IS NULL).

note: All 5 criteria verified against the actual files on disk (not just the diff/prior verdict): ingest/status.py, ingest/corroborate.py, ingest/fetchers/coinbase.py, the corroborations migration, tests/test_not_corroborated.py, and project-documents/11_Data_Model.md. Tests are assertion-bearing and exercise real code paths, not comment-only or vacuous. One real gap (not a criterion failure, since all criteria are method:test): run_live_corroboration/corroboration_is_failure are defined and unit-tested but never called from ingest/heartbeat.py, the actual dead-man's-switch entry point — confirmed by grep showing heartbeat.py only imports fetch_btc_daily_close/run_pipeline, never run_live_corroboration. The story's headline dead-man's-switch claim is proven only at the unit level, not end-to-end.
